usageNotes: Adds a named standard repository (identified by its handle) to the APT sources configuration on the target node. The target node must be online and reachable. Pass the digest returned by get_nodes_node_apt_repositories to guard against concurrent modifications — Proxmox will reject the write if the configuration has changed since you last read it.

examples.summary: Enable the no-subscription Proxmox VE repository on node 'pve1'

tips: Valid handle values are predefined by Proxmox and discoverable via the GET /nodes/{node}/apt/repositories response (look for 'standardRepos' entries with an 'handle' field).
This endpoint returns null on success — check HTTP 200 as your success indicator.
Adding a repository does not run 'apt-get update' automatically; call post_nodes_node_apt_update afterwards to refresh the package index.
The digest parameter is optional but strongly recommended in automation to prevent race conditions on shared clusters.
